title: 开始阅读最后更新：2026-07-24 02:09:56 最新章节：第一千八百七十三章 逐玉之樊长玉
content_zh:
“姜辰，我们分手吧！以后你也不要来找我了，你给不了我想要的生活。”
一个清脆悦耳的声音在姜辰的耳边响起。
姜辰抬头看去，却看到坐在他对面的女子面无表情的站了起来，然后向外走去。
“她是谁？这里是哪里？”
姜辰眼中露出了迷茫之色。
他明明记得自己是出租房中，怎么一觉醒来出现在一个陌生的地方。
难道有人跟他恶作剧？
这时，一股记忆出现在了他的脑海中。
“我竟然……”
在消化了记忆之后，姜辰才知道自己穿越。
不过这也没有什么接受不了的。
反正他前世是个孤儿，穿越了也没什么。
只是。
按照记忆，好像自己并不是穿越到了平行空间，而是穿越到了影视世界。
刚才离开的女人名叫王漫妮，是三十而已电视剧的女主角之一。
而他是王漫妮的前男友姜辰？
就在这时，他的脑海中突然响起了几道冰冷的机械音。
【检测到宿主符合签到条件……】
【系统正在激活中……】
【激活成功，宿主可进行签到……】

接二连三的提示，让姜辰目瞪口呆。
这是什么情况？
系统？签到？
拥有多年网文经验的他，自然知道系统是什么。
姜辰试着掐了自己一下。
嘶，很疼！
不是做梦！
“什么时候才能签到？日日签，月月签，还是年签？”
姜辰念头一动，在脑海中试探着问道。
【影视世界的每一个女主面前皆可签到。】
【每人仅限于一次。】
机械而冷漠的声音再次响起，随后便彻底沉寂了下去，无论姜辰再怎么提问，声音都没有再出现过。
姜辰脑海中念头一闪，他大概知道了，这个系统之所以会激活，是因为刚才王漫妮在他的面前。
不过，每一个女主的面前皆可签到是什么意思？
女主，是女一号，还是包括不限于女一号？
难道他只能在王漫妮，顾佳和钟晓芹面前刚签到一次？还是穿越的影视世界不仅仅是三十而已的影视世界，而是综合影视世界？
“系统，签到！”
姜辰收回发散的思维，心中默念道。
【恭喜宿主，签到成功，获得金融投资精通。】
系统机械而冷漠的声音再次响起。

无数关于金融投资的知识瞬间冲入了姜辰的脑海中，让他在短短的几个呼吸间，便彻底吃透了这个技能。
金融投资就是用资金购买股票、债券等金融资产的投资活动。
姜辰的前世也玩过股票，不过那是属于被割的韭菜。
现在在消化了这些知识后，姜辰才明白前世有多么的幼稚。
现在有了这些知识，以后就可以在金融市场叱咤风云了。
content_en:
"Jiang Chen, let's break up! Don't come to me anymore. You can't give me the life I want."
A clear and sweet voice sounded in Jiang Chen's ears.
Jiang Chen looked up and saw the woman sitting opposite him standing up expressionlessly and walking out.
"Who is she? Where is this?"
Jiang Chen's eyes showed confusion.
He clearly remembered that he was in a rental house, so why did he wake up in a strange place.
Was someone playing a prank on him?
At this time, a memory appeared in his mind.
"I actually..."
After digesting the memory, Jiang Chen knew that he had traveled through time.
But this is nothing unacceptable.
Anyway, he was an orphan in his previous life, so it would be okay if he traveled through time.
only.
According to my memory, it seems that I have not traveled to a parallel space, but to the world of film and television.
The woman who left just now is named Wang Manni, and she is one of the heroines of the thirty-year-old TV series.
And he is Wang Manni’s ex-boyfriend Jiang Chen?
At this moment, several cold mechanical sounds suddenly sounded in his mind.
[It is detected that the host meets the sign-in conditions...]
[The system is being activated...]
[Activation is successful, the host can sign in...]
Jiang Chen was stunned by the prompts one after another.
What is going on?
system? Sign in?
With many years of online writing experience, he naturally knows what the system is.
Jiang Chen tried pinching himself.
Hiss, it hurts!
Not a dream!
"When can I sign in? Daily sign, monthly sign, or annual sign?"
Jiang Chen had a thought and asked tentatively in his mind.
[You can sign in front of every heroine in the film and television world. 】
[Limited to one time per person. 】
The mechanical and indifferent voice sounded again, and then fell completely silent. No matter how Jiang Chen asked questions, the voice never appeared again.
A thought flashed in Jiang Chen's mind, and he probably knew that the reason why this system was activated was because Wang Manni was in front of him just now.
However, what does it mean that every heroine can sign in front of her?
Is the heroine the number one female lead, or is it inclusive but not limited to the number one female lead?
Could it be that he could only sign in once in front of Wang Manni, Gu Jia and Zhong Xiaoqin? Or is the film and television world traveled through not just the thirty-year-old film and television world, but a comprehensive film and television world?
"System, sign in!"
Jiang Chen retracted his divergent thoughts and thought silently in his heart.
[Congratulations to the host, you signed in successfully and gained mastery of financial investment. 】
The system's mechanical and indifferent voice sounded again.
Countless knowledge about financial investment rushed into Jiang Chen's mind instantly, allowing him to completely master this skill in just a few breaths.
Financial investment is the investment activity of using funds to purchase financial assets such as stocks and bonds.
Jiang Chen also played stocks in his previous life, but that was like cutting leeks.
Now after digesting this knowledge, Jiang Chen understood how naive he was in his previous life.
Now that you have this knowledge, you will be able to dominate the financial market in the future.
